decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology direction. With no website evidence of it since 2019, it looks like a low-value option whose resources are better redeployed to the core technology ventures.
The modular plant extensions are cheap add-ons to the core waste-to-energy platform and keep future deployment options open while demand for decentralized plants is still uncertain.
As a flagship decentralized waste-oil solution with a public launch, it is a strategic option whose uncertain but potentially large value justifies keeping it while market results unfold.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a focal flagship in a growing field, its value is not yet resolved, and abandoning it would forgo the firm's main growth option.
